description: US federal outlays by budget function (Net Interest, National Defense, Social Security, Medicare, Health, ...) plus total net outlays, total receipts and the deficit, from the U.S. Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement. Every row carries current-month, fiscal-year-to-date and prior-year-to-date dollars, the statement date it came from, and its basis (net outlays, nominal dollars, fiscal year Oct-Sep). Use for "net interest outlays FY2026", "federal spending on defense through August", "total outlays and deficit". Covers fiscal years 2015 onward; earlier years or statements not yet released return found:false with the reason, never an empty list. Omit fiscal_year/month for the latest statement.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year (Oct-Sep), e.g. 2026 = Oct 2025 through Sep 2026. With no month, returns the fiscal-year-end (September) statement, or the latest statement released in that year if it is not over.

function.description: Budget function to return, e.g. "Net Interest", "National Defense", "Medicare". Case-insensitive substring match. Omit for all functions.

month.description: Calendar month of the statement: 1-12 or a name ("September"). With fiscal_year picks that month of that fiscal year; alone picks the most recent such month published.

name: treasury_outlays

found.description: false when the period is not covered or not yet released; see reason

title: Treasury Outlays
